messages:
maya: Quick note — all-hands tomorrow 10:00 PT (25m). Short agenda and Q&A doc below. Please add questions or drop them here. :calendar:

maya: Agenda (25m):
- 10:00-10:05 Exec update (strategy priorities + hiring ask)
- 10:05-10:12 Product highlight  runtime optimizations + perf numbers
- 10:12-10:18 Policy update  new default log retention & opt-out path
- 10:18-10:25 Live Q&A (top upvoted)

maya: Q&A doc: https://docs.google.com/redwood-allhands-qna-springboard (upvote to prioritize)

amir: Heads-up: policy change will set default retention to 60 days for debug indices; projects can opt-out in Project Settings > Data retention. Migration guide incoming.

tina: Added migration steps and an export example to the Q&A doc: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/export -d '{"project":"teamx","range":"60d"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'```

lucas: Ops callout: runbook tweak — healthcheck preflight plus escalation to oncall+SRE lead after 4 failed retries. Ill paste the runbook diff in the doc.

maya: Managers: if you have headcount asks, put them in the hiring tracker by EOD. We'll surface top items at the end.

hr-bot: Reminder: submit headcount requests via https://hr.redwood.co/hiring-tracker by 18:00 PT today.

recording-bot: Recording will be uploaded after the meeting: https://records.redwood.co/meetings/1856007890-springboard-sync.mp4 (slides: https://slides.redwood.co/allhands/1856007890)

maya: Post-meeting notes (short):
- Exec: focus on reliability and customer SLAs; approved +2 infra hires and +1 product hire.
- Product: runtime perf improvements reduced 95/99 tail by ~12% in benchmark cluster.
- Policy: default debug-index retention -> 60 days; opt-out documented; migration docs live.
- Ops: runbook change deployed; weekly runbook smoke tests scheduled.

maya: If your question in the doc wasn't answered, we'll follow up in-thread and update the notes. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
